project.name: Dev Explorer
project.designRead: dev-tool explorer / developers / technical-minimal / information-dense / avoid centered max-width whitespace

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: monochrome zinc — #18181b near-black as primary for fills/active states; white surfaces; gray borders
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single monochrome brand scale, no secondary/accent hue; status uses green/red only for semantic feedback
colorSystem.stateColors: success #16a34a, destructive #dc2626 for status pills and alerts only

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius 12px standard, 6px small, 16px large; 1px borders structural not decorative; near-flat surfaces with minimal shadow
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Geist sans for UI, Geist Mono for code/data/numbers, DM Serif Display for editorial emphasis (sparingly)
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base unit; compact dashboard density; tight cards, measured gutters, compact navigation
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-led cards not shadow-led; dense calm buttons; quiet navigation with weight shifts; sidebar as first-class tonal pattern
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: flat surfaces, border contrast over elevation; shadow-sm max for cards; no decorative shadows
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: no photographs; CSS-mask SVG icons from library; monochrome iconography inheriting currentColor
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle hover bg shifts; active states use primary fill; no dramatic motion; developer-tool restraint

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: fixed left sidebar w-60 with workspace selector + nav items (总览/接口调试/日志/设置); top bar h-14 with breadcrumb + search + command palette hint + user avatar; full-bleed layout filling entire canvas width — NO centered max-width container, NO side padding gaps
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: monochrome zinc; #18181b primary fill for active nav/primary buttons; #fafafa muted surfaces; #e4e4e7 borders
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Geist sans 14px body, Geist Mono for code/paths/metrics, text-xs 12px for labels, text-lg for page titles
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: radius-md 12px for cards/containers, radius-sm 6px for small elements/pills, radius-lg 16px for large panels
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: white surface with 1px border; no shadow on static elements; shadow-sm only on dropdowns/popovers
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: primary button: bg #18181b text #fafafa radius 6px dense padding; secondary: border + surface; ghost: transparent hover muted
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content; toolbar rows aligned to grid; monospace numbers right-aligned in tables; consistent 4px spacing rhythm

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Monochrome zinc palette (#18181b primary, #ffffff surface, #e4e4e7 border). Geist sans + Geist Mono + DM Serif Display. 12px radius. 4px spacing. Flat surfaces with border contrast. 6 component families: button, card, table, chart, navigation, sidebar.

iconAssets.coloringRule: currentColor by default; override with Library token when needed

pages.title: 探索器总览
pages.businessScenario: Developer explorer dashboard — workspace overview with file tree sidebar, metric cards, recent activity table, and code snippet panel
pages.visualNorthStar: Full-bleed three-column dev-tool dashboard: left file-tree sidebar, center metrics+activity, right live status panel — no centered max-width, fills entire canvas
pages.compositionPattern: Three-column full-bleed: fixed sidebar (w-60) + flexible center (flex-1) + fixed right panel (w-80). Top bar spans full width. Content fills 100% canvas width with zero side margins.
continuityAnchors: left sidebar with workspace selector and nav items
top bar with breadcrumb + search + command-K hint
monochrome zinc palette with border-led cards
qualityRisks: three-column must fill full canvas width

pages.title: 接口调试
pages.businessScenario: API explorer debug interface — endpoint tree sidebar, request builder with parameters/headers/body, response panel with status/headers/JSON body
pages.visualNorthStar: Full-bleed three-column API explorer: left endpoint tree, center request builder with method badge + path + params table + code editor, right response viewer with status + JSON — fills entire canvas width
pages.compositionPattern: Three-column full-bleed: fixed sidebar (w-60) + flexible center (flex-1) + fixed right panel (w-96). Top bar spans full width. All panels fill 100% canvas height.
continuityAnchors: left sidebar with workspace selector and nav items
top bar with breadcrumb + search + command-K hint
monochrome zinc palette with border-led cards
qualityRisks: three-column must fill full canvas width
JSON response needs syntax-highlight-like monochrome treatment
method badges (GET/POST) need distinct but monochrome treatment
